record.context_brief: Yau conjecture on positive holomorphic sectional curvature
record.original_question: If a compact Kahler manifold X has positive holomorphic sectional curvature, must X be projective and rationally connected?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 3.1 (Yau's conjecture, [Yau82, Problem 47]). If a compact Kahler manifold X has positive holomorphic sectional curvature, then X is projective and rationally connected.
Yang in [Yan18a] solved Yau's conjecture by introducing the notion of the RC positivity

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a compact Kähler manifold. The holomorphic sectional curvature $H$ of $X$ is the restriction of the sectional curvature to complex lines in the tangent spaces; explicitly, for a nonzero tangent vector $v$ of type $(1,0)$, $H(v) = R(v,\bar v, v, \bar v)/\|v\|^4$, where $R$ is the curvature tensor of the Kähler metric. Say that $X$ has positive holomorphic sectional curvature if $H(v) > 0$ for every nonzero $(1,0)$ tangent vector $v$ at every point of $X$. Recall that $X$ is called projective if it admits a holomorphic embedding into some complex projective space, and rationally connected if any two points of $X$ can be joined by a chain of rational curves.

Prove or disprove: every compact Kähler manifold $X$ that admits a Kähler metric of positive holomorphic sectional curvature is projective and rationally connected.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture, due to Yau (Problem 47 in his 1982 problem list), was resolved affirmatively by Xiaokui Yang in 2018, who proved that a compact Kähler manifold with positive holomorphic sectional curvature is projective and rationally connected, using the notion of RC-positivity.

status_evidence.title: RC-positivity, rational connectedness and Yau's conjecture (X. Yang)
status_evidence.snippet: We prove that a compact Kähler manifold with positive holomorphic sectional curvature is projective and rationally connected, confirming a conjecture of S.-T. Yau.
status_evidence.claim: Yang proved Yau's conjecture that compact Kähler manifolds with positive holomorphic sectional curvature are projective and rationally connected.
